mapper.select: select fsd.id,fsd.create_time,fsd.update_time,fsd.create_user_name,fsd.create_user_id,fsd.update_user_name,fsd.update_user_id, fsd.version,fsd.is_deleted,fsd.main_id,fsd.asin,fsd.msku,fsd.fn_sku,fsd.sku_no,fsd.declare_qty,fsd.diff_qty, fsd.receive_qty,fsd.receive_date,fsd.is_combination,fsd.sku_id,fsd.delivery_qty,fs.code as shipmentCode from fba_shipment_detail fsd left join fba_shipment fs on fs.id = fsd.main_id and fs.is_deleted = false where fsd.is_deleted = false and fs.code = #{shipmentCode} and fsd.asin = #{asin} and fsd.msku = #{msku} limit 1
